about: module orchestrate's domain and memory store mutants; each is judged by the module's tests and laws (scripts/examples -modules orchestrate).

mutants.name: orch2-skip-command-reused
mutants.rule: Reusing an accepted CommandID with a different payload must fail CommandReused: IdempotentCommandID and Store.StoreIdempotentExecute.

mutants.name: orch2-allow-handback-without-claim
mutants.from:
try requireUnitAction(u, ActHandBack)
		try requireActiveOwner(u, c.Owner)
mutants.rule: HandBackUnit requires an active claim by the matching owner: UnitLifecycleOrder.

mutants.name: orch2-drop-receipt-on-fold
mutants.from: State{..state, Receipts: state.Receipts.Put(r.ID, r), ReceiptOrder: order}
mutants.rule: Apply(ReceiptRecorded) must project the receipt into State.Receipts so Fold and ReceiptsOf read it: ReceiptRecordedReadable and Store.StoreQueriesMatchSnapshot.

mutants.name: orch2-mutate-landed-commitment
mutants.from:
case CommitLanded, CommitDecided, CommitWithdrawn:
		InvalidTransition{Kind: "commitment", ID: c.ID, From: CommitmentStatusName(c.Status), Action: action}
mutants.rule: A landed commitment is monotone terminal and cannot be reassigned, relanded, or decided: CommitmentLandedMonotone.

mutants.name: orch2-reanswer-question
mutants.to:
case (QuestionAnswered, ActAnswer):
		Enter[QuestionStatus]{Next: QuestionAnswered}
	case (QuestionAnswered, ActWithdraw):
		Reject
	case (QuestionWithdrawn, ActAnswer | ActWithdraw):
		Reject
mutants.rule: An answered question cannot be answered again: FinalQuestionTakesNoAction and QuestionAnsweredOnce.

mutants.name: orch2-memory-appends-duplicate
mutants.rule: An idempotent resend must report Duplicate: true: Store.StoreIdempotentExecute.
